verdict.rationale: PayPal documents the core pieces of a payment flow: client-credentials token exchange, the PayPal Checkout button, server-side endpoints for capture, void and refund, a full sandbox, and OpenAPI specs that generate client code (e.g. Java). Braintree's GraphQL docs add a 'Create a transaction' guide and an end-to-end example integration. However, the only multi-language copy-paste snippets in evidence (cURL, Python, TypeScript) are for the MCP/LLM quickstart, not the checkout flow. Nothing shows a developer actually completing an integration within a day. missing for 10: copy-paste payment-flow code samples across multiple languages, evidence of time-to-first-payment under a day, independent/hands-on corroboration of docs-only integration.
